title: South Korea captain 'deeply sorry' for gloating about military exemption
summary: South Korea’s Asian Games football captain apologized on Sunday for boasting that his gold medal meant he did not have to do military service. South Korea defeated hosts Japan 1-0 on Saturday…

blocks.text: South Korea’s Asian Games football captain apologized on Sunday for boasting that his gold medal meant he did not have to do military service. South Korea defeated hosts Japan 1-0 on Saturday in the men’s final in Toyota, near Nagoya, for their fourth Games title in a row. Afterward, Lee Gi-hyuk smiled as he held up his gold medal to reporters and said: “I’m not going to the military.” Able-bodied South Korean males are usually required to perform between 18 months and two years of military service before the age of 28.
